7012.text:
7012 * navala 'new'. 2. * navalla-. [~ * navara -: cf. navalā - f. 'name of a woman' VP. — náva -¹] 1. M. navaḷkā 'new'; — H. nor (or < * navara - or návatara -). 2. Pk. ṇavalla -, ṇavullaḍaya -; S. navalu , navilo 'new,
shy', nolo 'new, strange'; Or. naüli , la° 'new, tender', sb.
'young woman'; G. navlũ 'new', naval f. 'a wonder',
M. naval n.; — altern. < * navala -: Ku. N. naulo 'new,
strange'; A. nomal , numaliyā 'born late in the season,
last born'; MB. na ( h ) alī f. adj. 'fresh, new'; Mth. nabal 'new' (dissim. from * namal ); OAw. navala 'fresh, unspoilt';
H. naul 'new, wonderful', m. 'sapling'. * navalla- 'new' see prec. Addenda: * navala- . 2. S.kcch. naulo 'strange'; — OP. navelā 'new, fresh, young'.

11504a.text: 11504a †* vātōdgūra- 'whirlwind'. [ vātá-, *udgūra -] WPah.kṭg. (kc.) bagur , bagər f. 'wind, air', J. bāgur f.; H. bagūrā , °ūlā m. 'whirlwind' (Him.I 131 cf. udguratē 'raises the voice threateningly').

6368.text:

as. dyrgha ; Kt. dr̥gə̃ŕ 'long', Pr. ǰignī́ (NTS xv 259
< * dīrghan -), Dm. drīga , Tir. dérega , Paš.dar. legā , ar. drīi (< MIA. * drīgha - ?); Woṭ. lig 'high (of a building)'. likh 'long (of time)'; Kal.urt. drhīga , rumb. drīga 'long,
tall', Bshk. lī ' g , līk , Tor. J̣īk , Mai. žiga , Chil. žiṅgo (NTS xv 259 < * dīrghan -), Sv. drigōᵘ , Phal. drigo , Sh.
gil. ẓĭgŭ (→ Ḍ. J̣īga ), S. ḍrigho , L. drigghā , (Ju.) dirighā ,
khet. driggā ; N. digho 'lasting long'; A. dīgh , dīghā 'length', B. digh , dig ; H. poet. dīha 'long'; Si. diga 'long, length'. — Ext. - r -: Pk. dīhara - 'long'; — l -: Ash. drigalä 'long', Wg. dr̥galäˊ , Paš.kuṛ. ligolo , Shum. ligalo , Gaw. lĭ̄gālá ; A. dīghal 'long, stretched out';
MB. dīghala 'long'. dīrghatara-, dīrghikā-, dairghá-, drāghmán-;
*dīrghapuccha-, dīrghā́yus-; ádīrgha-; — *draṅgha -¹. Addenda: dīrghá-: S.kcch. dhrigo 'high'; Md. digu 'long, tall'.

4939.text:
4939 cyávatē 'moves to and fro, retires' RV., 'drops from, trickles from' MBh., 'falls' R., 'perishes' Mn. [√ cyu ] Pa. cavati 'moves, falls away, dies'; Pk. cavaï , cayaï 'goes from birth to birth, dies'; Wg. čū - 'to walk, go
away, flow'; Pr. - čo - in li-čomasəm 'I stand up'; Dm. čō̃y -, 2 sg. imper. čō 'go!', Shum. ċō di , Woṭ. ċō (pret. gā < gatá -), Gaw. ċo , Bshk. čō , 1 pl. fut. čom , Tor.
(Biddulph) čoh ; Phal. čō 'rise, go!'; OG. cavaï 'falls', cavī 'fallen, reborn' (→ M. cavṇẽ 'to fall into debauchery,
become mad'); Si. senavā , he° 'to fall'; — Ku.
gng. cuāuṇo 'to cause (water or branches or leaves) to
fall', cuuṇa 'causing to fall' or < cyṓtati .

5523.text:

11168.text:

Sv. lohĩló 'red', Phal. lohílu , lᵊhōilo ; Sh.gil. jij. lēl m. 'blood', gil. lōlyŭ , (Lor.) loⁱlo 'red, bay (of horse

10680.text:
10680 rājana 'belonging to a royal family' Siddh. [ rā́jan -] Pk. rāṇa -, °aya - m. 'king' (or < rājñ - ?); Bshk. rān ,
f. rēn 'good' AO xviii 249; P. rāṇā m. 'prince', Ku. rāiṇ ; N. rānā 'title of Kṣatriyas whose ancestors have

'night'; Ash. dōs , dus 'yesterday', Kt. dū̆s , Wg. dōs , dūs , Pr. ulus , Dm. dōs , Tir. dō , Paš.lauṛ. dū , dar. duō , ar. də̄ , Niṅg. 9202.text:

dar. dāˋr , nij. dōr , kuṛ. dō m. 'firewood', ar. dōr tree';
Shum. Gaw. dār 'wood, tree'; Kho. dar 'timber, firewood,

'timber', Ku. N. H. dār m.; Si. dara 'firewood'. — Kal.rumb. dar 'ridge-pole' (or poss. < dhā́rā -²). 2. Pa. dāruka - 'wooden'; Dm. dâru , °ro 'wood' (or
< dā́rava -); Gaw. dā́ru (and dāṛu ?) 'rafter, plank.' dā́rava-, dāruṇá-, dārva-; *dārudhānaka-, *dārubhārika-; *akṣadāruka-, dēvadāru-, *sphānadāru -. dāruka- see prec. Addenda: dā́ru- ². 1. 'anything bright, welfare' Kauś. [√ śubh ] Pa. subha - 'bright, beautiful', n. 'welfare'; NiDoc. śubhāśubhas̱a gen. sg. 'good and bad'; Pk. subha -, suha - 'auspicious', n. 'good luck'; Phal. šuwo , šūo , f. šūī 'good', Sh. šo , f. ši 'good, better'; L.awāṇ. sūˋā 'red', P. H. sūhā ; A. xu 'good, auspicious, much'; — Si. suba 'fortunate, good fortune' (EGS 183) ← Pa. — Ext. - ll -: A. xuwalā 'elegant'; H. suhelā 'beautiful,
goodlooking', G. sohlũ 'good, auspicious', n. 'auspicious holiday'. * śubhatvana-; aśubha-; *śubhakāla-, *śubhavēla-. Addenda: śubha-: OP. suhīā f. 'prostration, woman's greeting to

6722.text:

m. 'master'; S. dhaṇī m. 'master' (whence dhañāṇī , dhãyāṇī f. 'mistress'); P. WPah.bhal. dhaṇī 'rich', m.
'rich man', N. dhani ; A. B. dhani 'rich'; Bi. dhanī 'moneylender'; Mth. dhani 'rich'; Aw.lakh. dhanī 'master'; H. dhanī 'rich', m. 'owner, creditor' ( dhanyānī f. 'mistress'); Marw. dhaṇī˜ m. 'owner'; G. dhaṇī m.
'master,' ( dhaṇiyāṇī f. 'mistress'); M. dhaṇī m. 'master'
( dhaṇīṇ f. 'mistress' < dhaninī -). — H. dhanī m., G. dhaṇī m. 'husband' poss. dhanika - s.v. dhanikā -. * ātmadhanika-, *mahiṣadhanin -. Addenda: dhanin-: WPah.kṭg. dhɔṇ i , kc. °ṇe m. 'master, lord',
OMarw. dhaṇĭ̄ .

10840.text:

ludh. rōnā , WPah.bhiḍ. roṇū , Ku. rūṇo (caus. roūṇo ),
N. runu (pret. royo ), B. royā , Mth. roeb , OAw. roi ,
H. ronā , OMarw. roi , G. rovũ . 2. Pa. rudati 'weeps', Pk. ruaï , ruvaï , ruvvaï , Ash. ẓū -, žū -, Wg. wŕu -, wŕö -, Kt. ẓu -, Pr. ẓū -, žū -,
Tir. ru - (1 sg. pres. rum , 3 sg. rūi ), Phal. 1 sg. pres. rūm ; K. riwun 'to mourn'; S. rũaṇu 'to weep', la. rūṇu . — See * ruṇṇa -. Addenda: rōdati . 1. WPah.kṭg. rōṇõ , J. roṇu , ruṇu , kṭg. caus. rwauṇõ ; Md. ronī 'weeps' (inf. rōn , absol. roi , rō ; ruim 'weeping'). 2. rudáti: OP. rūāvaṇu 'to cry out, lament'. † rōdhati see rōdhayati .

8201.text:
8201 pipīlá m. 'ant' RV., °laka - m. 'large black ant' ChUp., pipī́likā - f. 'small red ant' AV., pīlaka - m. 'ant' lex.
2. * piphīla-. 3. * pippīla-. 4. * pipphīla-. 5. * pippīḍa-. 6. * pilīla-. [Variety of MIA. and NIA.
forms for 'ant' may be due partly to its (unknown) nonAryan origin (EWA ii 285), partly to contamination
with kīṭá - and kŕ̥mi -, but mainly to some sort of taboo
for a noxious insect. Although there appear to be six
main types, not all NIA. forms can be grouped exactly
under them] 1. Pa. pipīlikā -, pipillikā - f. 'ant', Pk. pipīliā - f., °lia - m., pivīliā - f., Wg. pīmilī́k , pilī́k , Gaw. pilo , Tor. pel f.; — dissim. of p — p (Wackernagel AiGr i Nachträge
158) or X kīṭá -: Pa. kipillaka - m., °likā - f., Aś. kq. aṁbā-kipilikā nom. pl., top. - kapīlika , rdh. - kapilika 'a kind of ant', S. kiulī f., kĩulī f. (X kŕ̥mi - ?); L. kavīlī f.
'small red ant'; N. kamilo , (< * kãwilo rather than
< karmín -). 2. Kal.urt. phīwilík 'ant'; L. pehlā m. 'large black
ant', °lī f. 'small red ant' (< * pahĭ̄l -), awāṇ. pḕlā , °lī ;
WPah.śeu. pr i ùli 'ant', l.rudh. pr i v̀lli (X * priśu - ?),
khaś. h.rudh. b i ùli . 3. Or. pipīḷi 'ant'; — P. piplīhī f. (cf. Pk. forms with - p - in 1 ab.). 4. Dm. phipilī́ , phempilī 'ant'. 5. OB. piṁpaḍā 'ant', MB. pĩpīṛā , B. pĩp ( i ) ṛā , pipiṛā ,
Or. pimpuṛi , Mth. pipṛī ; H. pipṛā m. 'large black ant', °ṛī f. 'small red ant'; — Pk. pippaḍā - f. 'a kind of ant'
(cf. * pippa -²); A. piparā 'ant' ( paruwā 'ant' < * pawarā < * papaḍa - ?). 6. Kal.rumb. pilī́lyΛk 'ant', Kho. pilíli , Bshk. pilíl ,
Phal. pilī́lu m.; — Sh. phĭlīli̯ f. Addenda: pipīlá- . 1. WPah.kṭg. ph í mpəṛ i f. 'butterfly', J. fimfṛi f.; — kṭg. k i mbl i , kh í mbl i f. 'ant' with dissimilation of ph-p to kh-b as bh-ph to g-ph in †* bāhuṣphara -. 5. * pippīḍa-: A. also pipãrā (AFD 211), OA. pimparā 'ant'.

3777] Pa. makkaṭa - m. 'monkey', °ṭī - f., NiDoc. makaḍ'a F. W. Thomas AO xii 40, Pk. makkaḍa - m., °ḍī f., maṁkaḍa -, °kaṇa - m., Ap. makkala - m., Kt. makeŕ ,

3364.text:
3364 kuśa ² 'depraved, mad, inebriate' lex. [Cf. kuśi - m. 'owl', kuśika - 'squint-eyed', Kuśiká - nom. prop. RV.] Sh. (Lor.) kuš 'one-horned (of ibex, markhor, etc.)', kušo 'maimed, crippled', kušulo 'having a bit broken off
(e.g. a cup), maimed (?)'.

12613.text:
12613 * śaitala 'relating to cold'. 2. * śaitalya- 'coldness'.
[ śītalá- ] 1. Ku. selo 'cold, shady, damp', selūṇo 'to let get
cold'; N. selāunu 'to become cold, be disheartened';
OAw. serāvaï 'cools', lakh. serāb 'to become cool'; H. serānā 'to become cold'; M. śeḷ f. 'rice land which
keeps humidity and coolness throughout the hot
weather', śeḷṇẽ 'to grow stale'; Ko. śeḷo 'humid'; Si. häl , äl 'cold, frigid, coldness' (or < śaiśirá- ? ). 2. S. selāpaṇu 'to let get damp'; WPah.bhal. śellu n.
'coldness'. Addenda: * śaitala-: WPah.kṭg. śéḷɔ m. 'coldness', rarely adj.
'cold', kc. śeḷo adj. 'cold'. * śaimbala- see śalmalí- Add². * śaimbiya- see śaimbya- Add².

'region, country'; Pk. dēsa - m. 'part, country'; Gy.

'country', dēša 'far, distant'; Phal. dēš , dīš 'village'; Paš.
